gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.description: Downward acceleration. 0.5 is half gravity; 1 is normal.

speed.label: Movement speed
speed.description: Movement speed for every player. 2 is twice normal.

air_acceleration.label: Air steering
air_acceleration.description: Steering acceleration in mid-air. Lower values make direction changes harder.

crouch_speed.label: Sneaking speed
crouch_speed.description: Movement while crouching, multiplied with overall speed.

time_of_day.label: Time of day
time_of_day.description: Set the clock once: 0 midnight, 6 sunrise, 12 noon, 18 sunset. Does not freeze the clock.

time_speed.label: Day/night speed
time_speed.description: Clock rate. 0 freezes the time, 72 is the normal 20-minute day, 144 is twice as fast.

bounce.label: Bounce pads
bounce.description: Live bounce-pad effect. 0 disables it, 1.5 is normal. Enabling supplies eight reusable pads to each player once; place them on the ground. No restart.
